summary: Pull day, so emphasis stays on protein with steady carbs around lifting. Lunch builds a lean chicken-and-quinoa bowl with avocado and asiago for healthy fat/calories, and dinner swaps in roasted citrus shrimp for variety alongside more chicken breast and sweet potato.
